next_slices.rule: Review exact diffs, run focused validation, and commit only coherent control-plane changes.
Split live-product mirror edits by feature and test before deploy.
Promote only artifacts with validation evidence; archive or ignore generated churn.
Do not commit by default; archive or add ignore rules after evidence review.
